construction.definition: For eta=(eta_1,...,eta_n), all but one eta_j equal -(L-mu)/2, and the remaining eta_j ranges over [-(L-mu)/2,(L-mu)/2]. Q_eta has top-left 2x2 block [[(L+mu)/2,eta],[eta,(L+mu)/2]], remaining diagonal mu. q=(Rmu/sqrt(2),Rmu/sqrt(2),0,...). f_j(w)=0.5 w^T Q_eta_j w-q^T w.
construction.hidden_objects: Which component has the varying off-diagonal and its value.
model_membership_refs: Eigenvalues of each 2x2 block lie in [mu,L]; the remaining eigenvalues equal mu.
construction.public_information: n,L,mu,R and the form of the family; initialization independent of eta.

context_scope.ALGORITHMS: Oblivious canonical linear iterative methods only: iterates are sums of oracle outputs; oracle parameters and index-selection rules may be random but cannot depend on previous oracle answers. Side information n,L,mu is public.
context_scope.GUARANTEE: Worst-case iteration complexity within the oblivious CLI class, expectation over algorithm randomization.
context_scope.MODEL: Each f_j is L-smooth and mu-strongly convex on Euclidean R^d; 0<mu<L; kappa=L/mu.
context_scope.ORACLE: Generalized component-gradient O(w;A,B,C,j)=A grad f_j(w)+Bw+C and exact one-coordinate component minimization.
context_scope.RESOURCE: Source CLI iterations; not a universal unrestricted-query lower bound. Dimension can be fixed >=2 for the joint oracle construction.
